metadata.title: Extra Virgin Olive Oil Tasting in Tuscany | Frantoio del Pasqua Arezzo
metadata.description: Discover the true flavors of Tuscan EVO oil. Book a tasting of extra virgin olive oil at Frantoio del Pasqua in Monte San Savino, Arezzo.

hero.subtitle: Tours & tastings
hero.description: A guided sensory journey to learn how to recognize the aromas and notes of extra virgin olive oil, discover our cultivars, and experience the mill up close.

classica.title: Visit and tasting
classica.subtitle: Come visit us directly at the Mill in Monte San Savino and discover everything there is to know about extra virgin olive oil and olives.
includes: Description and explanation of olive cultivation and the typical varieties of the area
Knowledge of the different methods of cultivation, harvesting, production, and storage
Guided tasting to learn to recognize the sensory qualities of olive oil and identify any defects
Tasting of our oils paired with local products: stone-ground bread bruschetta, fresh pinzimonio vegetables, and a glass of Rosso di Sangiovese

premium.title: Field experience
premium.subtitle: A unique experience in the olive grove at Pozzo della Chiana with a picnic BBQ and milling at the olive mill.
includes: Warm welcome by Marta at our olive grove in Pozzo della Chiana with views of the Temple of Santo Stefano della Vittoria
Traditional hand picking of olives using only a small comb and collection nets
Picnic lunch with a barbeque directly in the olive grove under the trees
Visit to the family mill to mill the previously harvested olives, following the process step by step to the fresh oil
Final tasting of extra virgin and flavored olive oils with bruschetta

faq.q1: Where do the tastings take place?
faq.a1: The tours and tastings take place right inside our Frantoio del Pasqua, located in Loc. Infernaccio 510/B, Monte San Savino (in the province of Arezzo). You will discover how our oil is born surrounded by the extraction machinery.
faq.q2: What does the analysis in the mill consist of?
faq.a2: We will guide you to discover our cultivars. You will learn to recognize the fruity, bitter, and spicy notes that characterize a true high-quality Tuscan extra virgin olive oil.
faq.q3: How long does the experience last and what does it include?
faq.a3: The experience lasts from 30 to 90 minutes. It includes an illustration of the continuous cycle pressing process and technical tasting, often enriched by refined gastronomic pairings.
faq.q4: Is it possible to purchase oil at the end?
faq.a4: Certainly. You can buy our cold-pressed evo oil directly in our farm shop. A perfect and exclusive souvenir of Arezzo's excellence.

header.subtitle: History
header.description: The Del Pasqua company was born around the 1960s in Valdichiana, modifying over time, evolving and aiming to focus on diversification, focusing on the quality of the products, on innovation, respecting the environment, without losing sight of the values and flavors of the true Tuscan and Italian tradition, opening up to new outlets and directions both in the olive-growing and wine-making fields. The entire production chain is carried out in our territory, from the cultivation of olive trees and vines, through harvesting up to the packaging of the finished product.

section1.subtitle: The olive groves
section1.p1: Our olive groves extend over 4 hectares, divided among the typical cultivars of the area.
section1.p2: In respect of traditional cultivation, but using modern and innovative techniques, new olive trees have been planted whose status is constantly monitored by the agronomist who evaluates the ripeness of the olives.

section2.subtitle: The harvest
section2.p1: Harvesting takes place 'at the right moment' to obtain an oil rich in polyphenols, aromas, and taste. The olives are processed on the same day with cold extraction in our latest generation olive mill.
section2.p2: Today, our products are suitable for every type of diet, united by the common thread of quality but addressing a transverse market, from those who appreciate an intense and fruity oil to those who use a lighter and more delicate oil, without forgetting children's nutrition during the weaning period.

philosophy.subtitle: Philosophy
philosophy.description: A family story, patient work, and constant care: quality is born from the sum of small gestures, repeated well, every year.

hero.label: Mill
hero.description: At the mill, every detail counts: from cleaning the olives to controlled malaxation, extraction, and storage. Here, technology and artisanal care work together to preserve freshness, aromas, and stability.

frangitura.title: Crushing
frangitura.desc: Rapid crushing to minimize heating and oxidation.

gramolazione.title: Malaxation
gramolazione.desc: Slow mixing to combine micro-drops of oil.

estrazione.title: Extraction
estrazione.desc: Separation without thermal stress, monitored parameters.

separazione.title: Separation
separazione.desc: Refinement and clarification of the oil.

filtrazione.title: Filtration
filtrazione.desc: Stability over time and clean profile.

divider_1.label: CARE AND CONSERVATION
divider_1.text: Once extracted, we protect our oil from light and oxygen. Only this way do the mill's aromas arrive intact on your table.

divider_2.label: GUARANTEED QUALITY
divider_2.text: We leave nothing to chance: from the arrival of the olives to the checks on the final product.

trasporto.title: Cleanliness and stability
trasporto.text: Inside the mill, the oil moves only through stainless steel containers. Plastic is excluded because it can transfer off-flavors and compromise the product's clarity, aroma, and stability.

stoccaggio.title: Storage under nitrogen
stoccaggio.text: After extraction, the oil is stored in stainless steel tanks protected from light, temperature swings, and oxygen exposure. Nitrogen storage helps preserve aromas, freshness, and polyphenols until bottling.

imbottigliamento.title: Filling and packaging line
imbottigliamento.text: Our bottling line handles different formats, precise labeling, and orderly packaging while maintaining continuity and cleanliness throughout the final stage of the process.

controllo.title: Quality and traceability
controllo.text: Each batch is followed carefully from olive delivery to final packaging. Traceability, process checks, and verification on the finished oil help us keep the mill's quality consistent.

technology.label: The Mill
technology.description: In our mill, every phase is designed to protect aromas and polyphenols: rapid delivery, careful cleaning, cold extraction, and storage in controlled conditions.

steps_section.label: Production
steps_section.subtitle: Harvest, processing, and certifications: the stages that guide the quality of our extra virgin olive oil.

brucatura.title: Hand picking
paragraphs: Even today in Tuscany, much of the olive harvest takes place traditionally, with hand picking; the olives transported to the mill are then processed within 12 hours to safeguard the integrity of the aromatic and phenolic components. The family-run Del Pasqua Mill, recently renovated near Monte San Savino, recently built with green building and energy saving criteria, is equipped with a modern Alfalaval olive processing plant with cold extraction.

imbottigliamento.title: The bottling line
paragraphs: The plant is equipped with a line for bottling and packaging; and a nitrogen storage to guarantee the organoleptic characteristics of the oil while waiting for bottling.
But we don't stop here: we perform milling and packaging processes for third parties.

evo.title: Our EVO Oil
paragraphs: All these factors are an absolute guarantee for the production of extra virgin olive oil of the highest quality, capable of preserving the freshness and aromas that characterize freshly squeezed oil for longer.

igp_bio.title: IGP AND BIO
paragraphs: Our Italian extra virgin olive oil is not only born from olives grown with respect for the environment, but all activities for its processing are subject to the control regime of recognized bodies to guarantee the end consumer a natural, controlled, and certified product. The Del Pasqua mill is certified Suolo e Salute for the transformation and production of Bio products and is registered with the Tuscan Oil Consortium for the production of IGP Toscano extra virgin olive oil.

iqo.title: IQO Certification
iqo.text: Our extra virgin olive oil is IQO certified; chemical and scientific analyses guarantee a high natural nutritional value, stable conservation over time, and a security of accurate traceability without risk of fraud.

intro.title: Our EVO oil
body: Our Italian extra virgin olive oil is not only born from olives grown with respect for the environment, but all activities for its processing are subject to the control regime of recognized bodies to guarantee the end consumer a natural, controlled, and certified product. The Del Pasqua mill is certified Suolo e Salute for the transformation and production of Bio products and is registered with the Tuscan Oil Consortium for the production of IGP Toscano extra virgin olive oil.

Our extra virgin olive oil is IQO certified; chemical and scientific analyses guarantee a high natural nutritional value, a stable conservation over time, and a security of accurate traceability without risk of fraud.
